title: Split Gibbs Discrete Diffusion Posterior Sampling
contribution_one_line: A plug-and-play split-Gibbs posterior sampler for DISCRETE diffusion models (reward guidance + inverse problems), with an O(1/K) convergence guarantee.
reproduction_approach: Verify the sampler mechanically on the paper's synthetic controlled-posterior study (exact ground truth, CPU, no weights); document real-data tasks as SEDD-90M-gated.
